name: Epoch Archive Studios
niche: Indian city histories: founding, rulers, wars, trade, culture, food, geography, strange facts

language.script: Devanagari Hindi, simple spoken Hindustani (avoid heavy Sanskritised or Urdu words)

hook.rule: Open with a curiosity question that lands within the first 5 seconds
hook.example: Kya aap jaante hain is shehar mein itni jheelein kyun hain?

voice.description: Sutradhar's voice, a deep resonant Indian male voice that is soft and gentle with a curious, wondering tone, natural storytelling pace that is slightly brisk, never slow or dragging, clear standard Hindi.
voice.notes: Owner rejected edge-tts Madhur samples. Flow cannot lock one exact voice: same VOICE block in every prompt, regenerate clips whose voice drifts. Fallback if drift is too high: fixed TTS voice (Gemini TTS / Sarvam) + finishing step.

style.visual: 2D vintage noir storybook cartoon (Quiet Wolf style family, own characters)

goal.until_2027_01_31: 1000 subs + 4000 public watch hours/12 months OR 10M Shorts views/90 days
goal.from_2027_02_01: 1000 subs + 8000 watch hours/365 days OR 20M Shorts views/90 days
goal.earlier_tier: 500 subs + 3000 watch hours/12 months OR 3M Shorts views/90 days (fan funding, Shopping)
goal.cadence: 4 Shorts/week (Mon, Tue, Thu, Sat) + 1 long episode every 2 weeks (Sun); Google AI Pro credits
goal.target: 1000 subs + 8000 long-form watch hours within 12 months of EP1; stretch: in YPP before 2027-02-01
